Steamboat Springs, Colorado · eat

Restaurants in Steamboat Springs for cyclists

Where to eat in Steamboat Springs the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: SBT GRVL.

Restaurants in Steamboat Springs for cyclists, listed

  1. Aurum Food & Wine

    New American · 811 Yampa St, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Riverfront patio on Yampa Street, a block from the start line.

  2. The Laundry

    Shared plates, smoked and cured · 127 11th Street, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Seasonal shared-plate menu in a converted laundry downtown.

  3. Salt & Lime

    Mexican · 628 Lincoln Avenue, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Tacos and tequila on Lincoln Avenue; easy post-ride carbs.

  4. Creekside Cafe

    Breakfast and lunch · 131 11th Street, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Open daily 7 a.m. to 2 p.m.; patio on Soda Creek; the pre-race breakfast spot.

  5. Mountain Tap Brewery

    Brewpub, wood-fired · 910 Yampa Street, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Beer and wood-fired food on Yampa Street, in the same building as Ride Workshop.
